summary: Rentokil Initial plc filed a Form 6-K furnishing a UK TR-1 major holdings notification, the US equivalent of a Schedule 13G/13D amendment. BlackRock, Inc., acting as the reporting holder, disclosed that on 02-Oct-2026 its total interest crossed above the previous level to 13.44% of voting rights, comprising 10.14% held in shares (256,149,103 votes) and 3.30% through financial instruments, including ADRs, securities lending, cash-settled CFDs and an ELN maturing 08-Oct-2026. The issuance concerns shareholder disclosure only, not a special situation. No board recommendation, advisor, deal terms or transaction mechanics are stated. Watch for further stake movements, derivative unwinds and any shift toward activism.
